forager_camp.name: Forager Camp
forager_camp.note: Bootstrap food from the wild. Low yield, no inputs, no land needed.

farm.name: Farm
farm.note: Primary food. Output scales with soil fertility and tool coverage; drains fertility.

compost_yard.name: Compost Yard
compost_yard.note: Restores soil fertility. The counter to monocrop exhaustion.

granary.name: Granary
granary.note: Raises food storage capacity; storage above stock suppresses spoilage.

house.name: Housing Block
house.note: Housing capacity. Overcrowding halts growth and erodes morale.

mine.name: Iron Mine
mine.note: Finite, depleting deposit. Output scales with tool coverage.

smelter.name: Smelter
smelter.note: Ore + wood -> steel. Needs SKILLED labor (made by schools).

toolsmith.name: Toolsmith
toolsmith.note: Steel -> tools. Tools are capital that boost farms/mines; they wear out (maintenance loop).

school.name: School
school.note: Institution. Converts unskilled -> skilled labor over time (only when food is in surplus).
